title: American Greed
description:
S4 E7 — Funny Money
Albert Talton puts a modern twist on one of the nation's oldest crimes - making counterfeit money.

title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
description:
S1 E10 — A Crash or a Kill Mystery
Wealthy retired executive Ken Abbott and his wife, Celeste, are said to have died in a fiery car crash in New Jersey, but when the family can't get answers to simple questions about their deaths, police discover a gruesome crime motivated by greed.

title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
description:
S1 E1 — Bound for Murder
Fontainebleau Miami Beach hotel heir Ben Novack Jr. is bludgeoned to death three months after his mother, Bernice, is found dead under suspicious circumstances; Novack's wife, Narcy, a former stripper, becomes the key to unlocking this sordid case.

title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
description:
S1 E2 — The Dungeon Master
Wealthy suburbanite Jane Bashara is found strangled to death in a seedy part of Detroit known for drugs, crime and murder; a handyman is charged, but that's only the beginning of the story which is ultimately about sex, lies and betrayal.

title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
description:
S1 E3 — A Glittering Murder
Living a golden life, entrepreneurs James and Pamela Fayed turn a fledgling coin company into a gold trading empire; after Pamela is brutally stabbed to death, her murder case reveals a federal fraud investigation and a marriage filled with lies.

title: American Greed
description:
S6 E15 — Lee Farkas/Taylor Bean & Whitaker: Financial Home Invasion
Lee Farkas invents fake loans and funnels millions in a scam that leaves thousands jobless and leads to one of the largest bank failures in America.

title: American Greed
description:
S6 E8 — Loan Scam: Money for Nothing; Hawaiian Punched: Fraud in Paradise
A sting operation brings down a Denver businessman; a charismatic con man uses the promise of huge returns to put $30 million in his own pocket.

title: American Greed
description:
S5 E14 — Mark Weinberger: Nose No Bounds
An esteemed doctor turns to white-collar crime and becomes a most-wanted fugitive.

title: American Greed
description:
S6 E1 — Kenneth Starr: Naked Greed: Celebrity Scam Artist
An accountant to stars mismanages clients' money, pockets millions and marries an exotic dancer.

title: American Greed
description:
S5 E1 — Stephen Trantel: Bank Robbing Broker
The story of Wall Street whiz, Stephen Trantel, a one-time successful commodities broker who turns to bank robbing to support his greedy lifestyle.
